action: Repair field roads and harvesting paths
Run a Ganoderma census; sanitise and isolate infected palms
Cut the harvest round to 10 days (good practice is 7 to 10); rebalance harvest teams
Install or repair water gates and outlets in flood-prone blocks
Census bagworm; apply biological or targeted chemical control
Raise potassium (MOP) in the next round, then re-sample leaf 17
Clear and deepen drains; check outlets before the wet season
Apply kieserite for magnesium, then re-sample leaf 17
Bring weed cover under 15% with targeted circle and path weeding
